title: Avatar picker
one_line: Arch-top NX Card, grid of avatars, locked ones showing how to unlock.

anatomy.spec: NX Card, arch variant (bible 5.4) for the rounded top.
Grid of circular avatars, 4 per row, selected one with a cream ring, locked ones faded with a lock badge (bible 5.15).
SELECT, go green, collar. Disabled if nothing changed.

states: Locked - faded, lock badge, tapping shows the unlock hint instead of selecting

assets_needed.name: Avatar set
assets_needed.prompt: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 6, P2-1: 12-16 portraits, mascot variants in outfits and house colours, 512 px square.

do_not: Do not let a locked avatar be selected - tapping it only shows the hint.
Do not use eleven copies of one avatar - the old zip's Ellipse 12-22 duplication is exactly what this replaces.
acceptance: Grid shows owned and locked correctly.
SELECT only enables on a real change to an unlocked avatar.
steps: 2. Build the arch-top card with the grid.
5. Capture owned, locked and selected. Postflight.
prompt:
Build the Ludo NX Avatar Picker popup.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 5.4 (arch variant) and 5.15, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

This does not exist yet. Build it on the arch-top NX Card: nameplate SELECT AVATAR, a 4-per-row grid of circular avatars, the current selection with a cream ring, locked ones faded with a lock badge and an unlock hint on tap (never selectable), and SELECT in a collar, disabled until the selection actually changes.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
